{{Top|leg}}
'''Bordok Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it took part in an [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] on several [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] shipments of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s, but the attack failed largely due to the efforts of [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], and most, if not all, of the squadron was wiped out.
